user_direction: The solver is not selected. Prioritize a broad, bounded comparison of suitable solvers before architecture-specific refinement.
supersedes: Unlaunched single-CAD Hash P1/full10-supervision pilot; retained only as a deferred diagnostic hypothesis.
dataset: original DeepJEB v1.0; official CSV GRID coordinates aligned to H5 vertices

recipe.loss: Complete-case mean MSE in common TRAIN-only four-channel encoding; pointwise chunks weighted by their node counts before one optimizer step
recipe.sampling: Four independently shuffled passes of all TRAIN120 cases using Python Random(seed); identical stored order for every family, independent of model RNG
recipe.selection_score: 0.5 * (validation case-mean physical U-vector relative L2 + validation case-mean signed-stress relative L2)
recipe.selection: One common validation score; report fixed endpoint and full accuracy-cost curve as primary screening evidence
recipe.outputs: Original signed uXYZ [mm] and source signed scalar stress [MPa]; no teacher or gradient-loss preference for one family
recipe.shared_geometry: Same target-independent per-CAD boundary-node cloud, PointNet global32 for every family; re-encoded with gradient at each update
recipe.fno_frontend: Target-free trilinear node-splat feature means: occupancy1 + normalized xyz3 + all original25 features; append differentiable global32 in model
recipe.fno_query: Standard differentiable trilinear query of encoded4 grid at every original node, then physical decode; no voxel-label training
recipe.fno_limitation: Point-to-grid candidate, not historical TETRA10 volume-occupancy FNO. Report TRAIN3/VAL15 encoded-label roundtrip separately as representation diagnostic, not error lower bound.
recipe.transformer_context: Every original case node contributes; only official TS3 global two-pass chunks, never independent spatial blocks
recipe.transolver_pp_eval: Pinned upstream stochastic Gumbel behavior retained; fixed per-case evaluation RNG isolated from training RNG
recipe.scope_limit: Single recipe and seed, four passes is early screening rather than convergence or architecture elimination

selection_data: TRAIN and development-validation CADs only; final test CADs and dia stay reserved
common_observables: Geometry, physical scale, material, load and constraints; no target fields or learned case ID in inputs
primary_criteria: Unseen-CAD physical displacement and signed-stress error
Training and full-node inference time and peak GPU memory
report_separately: Compact screening versus original slides configurations

stages.name: evidence_and_reusable_adapters
stages.purpose: Use existing results and sources to define a lean comparison without repeating old experiments or audits.

stages.name: bounded_six_family_screen
stages.purpose: Compare candidate families on one common train/validation protocol and record accuracy-versus-cost. Recipe frozen before data preparation or training.

stages.name: shortlist_confirmation
stages.purpose: Give the best two or three routes a matched additional budget and necessary robustness checks before selecting a solver.

scope_notes: Different architectures need not have identical initial tensors or parameter counts; disclose capacity and budget.
Do not assume Hash is the winner.
Avoid parameter sweeps and repeated source/parent audits.
Use a single GPU queue; reuse prepared data and official implementations.
An incomplete screen or one local milestone does not complete the autonomous research goal.
